# Explicit squash messages take precedence over filling.

as 'Test <test@example.com>'
at '2026-11-06T20:00:00Z'

cd repo
git init
git commit --allow-empty -m Initial
gs repo init
git add feature.txt
gs branch create feature -m Feature

git config spice.message.fill.command mock-message
git config spice.message.fill true
env MOCK_MESSAGE_EXIT=8

gs branch squash --fill -m 'Explicit squash message'
git log -1 --format=%s
stdout '^Explicit squash message$'

gs branch squash --fill --message-file $WORK/message.txt
git log -1 --format=%s
stdout '^From file$'

-- repo/feature.txt --
feature
-- message.txt --
From file
